One guide, several routes: the registry extracts the PARTNER / SPOUSE route (VISA_SOURCE_OVERRIDES includeSections: overview, partner-spouse, proof-income-partner, knowledge-of-english, provide-information). Expected values are for that route.

Fee rule (#59): outside-UK application fee for joining a partner is £2,064. The IHS is printed as a TOTAL per length (not per year): for an adult staying 2 years and 9 months (the partner visa's length from outside the UK) it is £3,105. Expected as ONE surcharge component of 3105 GBP per application. VERIFIER: confirm this reading (the alternative, 1035 x 3, is not printed on this page).

Processing time (user decision, 2026-11-09): FULL RANGE: here the inside-UK time (8 weeks, meeting the financial and English requirements) is SHORTER than the outside-UK time (12 weeks), so the range is min 56 (inside) to max 84 (outside). The 'about 12 months' case for in-UK applicants who do not meet the financial and English requirements is not the standard case and is excluded. VERIFIER: confirm.

documentKinds (#187): the issue's two named examples (copies of the photo page = document, details of any criminal convictions = information) plus passport, TB results and certified translation, as the page's own wording says.

processingDaysMin.source: If you apply inside the UK and you meet the financial requirements and English language requirements, you’ll usually get a decision within 8 weeks.

processingDaysMax.source: If you apply outside the UK you’ll usually get a decision within 12 weeks.

validityPeriod.source: You can stay in the UK for up to 2 years and 9 months. After this, you’ll need to apply to extend your stay.

isExtendable.source: You can extend your visa more than once.
